end.summary:
Practised standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Identified 7/7 line examples unaided and told straight from curved lines in 1/1 example.
Found the target lines in letters and objects in 2/3 examples.
Initially mixed up T and L, then corrected the identification by turn 12; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Om practised naming lines by their direction and checking whether they were straight or curved, using letters such as V, T, L, H and A. Explaining the lines in T and L went well, and the T/L mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, invite Om to find one standing, one sleeping and one slanting line in nearby letters or objects and explain why.
